questions.question: 15 men and 21 women, working together, can do a job in 56 days, while 12 men and 24 women, working together, can do the same job in 64 days. In how many days can the same job be done by 18 men and 24 women, working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15 men + 21 women can do a job = 56 days

12 men + 24 women can do a job = 64 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Let, the man efficiency = M

The woman efficiency = W

According to the question:

⇒ (15 M + 21 W) × 56 = (12 M + 24 W) × 64

⇒ (15 M + 21 W) × 7 = (12 M + 24 W) × 8

⇒ 105 M - 96 M = 192 W - 147 W

⇒ 9 M = 45 W

⇒ M/W = 5/1

Total work = (15 M + 21 W) × 56

⇒ {(15 × 5) + 21) × 56} = (96 × 56) units

Total efficiency = 18 M + 24 W

⇒ (18 × 5) + 24 × 1 = 114 units

Required time taken to complete work = Total work/total efficiency

⇒ (96 × 56)/114 = (16 × 56)/19 = 47(3)/(19) days

**∴ The correct answer is 47(3)/(19) days.**

questions.question: During a division, Pranjal mistakenly took as the dividend a number that was 10% more than the original dividend. He also mistakenly took as the divisor a number that was 25% more than the original divisor. If the correct quotient of the original division problem was 25 and the remainder was 0, what was the quotient that Pranjal obtained, assuming his calculations had no error?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

New dividend = 110% × original dividend

New divisor = 125% × original divisor

**Formula used:**

Dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder 

**Calculation:**

Let the original dividend = 100x

Mistakenly increased dividend = 100 × 110% = 110x

Let original divisor = 100y

Mistankenly increased divisor = 100y × 125% = 125y

Dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder 

100x = 100y × 25 + 0

x/y = 25/1

Increased dividend = 110x = 110 × 25 = 2750

Increased divisor = 125y = 125 × 1 = 125

Quotient = 2750/125 = 22

**∴ The correct answer is 22. **

questions.question: If the selling price of an article is doubled, then the profit becomes four times. What was the original profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If the selling price of an article is doubled, then the profit becomes four times.

**Formula used:**

Profit = Selling price (S.P) - cost price (C.P)

Profit % = {profit (P) × 100}/C.P 

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ 4 × (S.P - C.P) = (2 × S.P - C.P)

⇒ 4 S.P - 4 C.P = 2 S.P - C.P

⇒ 2 S.P = 3 C.P

⇒ S.P/C.P = 3/2

Profit percentage = (P × 100)/C.P.

⇒ {(3 - 2) × 100}/2 = 100/2 = 50%.

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

questions.question: A person standing at a distance looks at a building having a height of 1000 metres. The angle between the top of the building and the ground is 30°. At what approximate distance (in metres) is the person standing away from the building.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of building = 1000 m

Angle of elevation = 30°

**Formula used:**

Tan θ = perpendicular/Base = P/B

Tan 30° = 1/√3

Value of √3 = 1.732 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e0647242a0747a3d09b3f012b8934bbd7c8c850a669a20bc25fbc5e90b5bf68.png] 

Tan 30° = AB/BC

⇒ 1/√3 = 1000/BC

⇒ BC = 1000√3

⇒ BC = 1000 × 1.732 = 1732 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1732 m.**

questions.question: A can do 20% of a job in 7 days and B can do 25% of the job in 7 days if they worked alone. How much of the job (in percentage) can they complete in 7 days if they worked together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do 20% of a job = 7 days

B can do 25% of the job = 7 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

A can do 20% of a job = 7 days

A can do 100% of a job = 7 × 5 = 35 days

B can do 25% of the job = 7 days

B can do 100% of the job = 7 × 4 = 28 days

According to the question:

⇒ A × 35 = B × 28

⇒ A/B = 4/5

Total work = A × 35 = 4 × 35 = 140 units

Both work together for 7 days = (5 + 4) × 7 

⇒ 9 × 7 = 63 units

Percentage job complete in 7 days = (63 × 100)/140

⇒ 9 × 5 = 45%

**∴ The correct answer is 45%.**

questions.question: A six-digit number Is divisible by 33. If 54 Is added to the number, then the new number formed will also be divisible by:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A six-digit number Is divisible by 33

**Formula used:**

Dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder

**Calculation:**

Dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder

⇒ 33 × q + 0 = 33q

If 54 is added to the dividend then,

New number = 33q + 54

⇒ 3 × (11q + 18)

So, we can clearly say that the new number is divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct option is 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__** 

Please note that this is the official paper of SSC and SSC has given the 3 as the correct answer, but 111111 is also the 6 digit number and if we add 54 it will be divisible by both 3 and 5.

In the given figure if AD ⊥ BC, AC = 26 units, CD = 10 units, BC = 42 units, ∠DAC = x and ∠B = y then the value of (6)/(cos x)-(5)/(cos y)+8tan y is:

questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD ⊥ BC ; ∠D = 90° 

AC = 26 units; CD = 10 units; BC = 42 units

∠DAC = x and ∠B = y

**Formula used:**

Pythagorean theorem:

H² = P² + B²

Cos θ = B/H ; tan θ = P/B

Where, H = hypotenuse; P = perpendicular; B = Base

**Calculation:**

In △DAC

⇒ AC² = AD² + CD²

⇒ 26² = AD2 + 10²

⇒ 676 = AD2 + 100

⇒ AD = √(676 - 100) = √576 = 24 units

In △ADB

BD = (BC - CD) = (42 - 10) = 32 units

⇒ AB2 = AD2 + BD2

⇒ AB2 = 242 + 322

⇒ AB2 = 576 + 1024

⇒ AB = √1600 = 40 units

From the question:

 (6)/(cos x)-(5)/(cos y)+8tan y

⇒ 6/(AD/AC) - 5/(BD/AB) + 8 × (AD/BD)

⇒ 6/(24/26) - 5/(32/40) + 8 × (24/32)

⇒ (6 × 26/24) - (5 × 40/32) + 8 × (24/32)

⇒ 6.5 - 6.25 + 6 

⇒ 6.25 = 25/4 units

**∴ The correct answer is 25/4 units.**

questions.question: A spherical ball of lead, 3 cm in diameter, is melted and recast into three spherical balls. The diameters of two of these balls are (3)/(2) cm and 2 cm, respectively. Find the diameter of the third ball.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of spherical ball (D)= 3 cm

Diameter of 1st small ball (D₁)= 1.5 cm

Diameter of 2nd small ball (D₂)= 2 cm

**Concept used:**

Total volume of small spherical balls = Volume of large spherical balls

**Formula used:**

Volume of spherical ball = (4/3) × π × R³

**Calculation:**

Let, the diameter of 3rd small spherical ball = D₃

Volume of (1st small spherical ball + 2nd spherical ball + 3rd spherical ball) = volume of large spherical ball

⇒ 4/3 π × (D1/2)³ + 4/3 π × (D2/2)3 + 4/3 π × (D3/2)3 = 4/3 π (D/2)³

⇒ 4/3 π × [(1.5/2)3 + (2/2)3 + (D3/2)3 ]= 4/3 π (3/2)3

⇒ [(3.375/8) + 1 + (D3/2)3 ] = 3.375

⇒ (D3/2)3 = 2.375 - (3.375/8)

⇒ (D3/2)3 = (19 - 3.375)/8

⇒ D3 = ³√15.625 = 2.5

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5.**

questions.question: A part of a journey is covered in 37.5 minutes at 90 km/h and the remaining part in 14 minutes at 80 km/h. The total distance (in km} of the journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The time taken to complete first part of the journey = 37.5 minutes

The speed of a person in first part of the journey = 90 km/h

The time taken to complete remaining part of the journey = 14 minutes

The speed of a person for remaining part of the journey = 80 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance travelled by a person in first part = (90 × 37.5)/60 = 225/4 = 56(1)/(4) km

Distance travelled by a person in second part = (80 × 14)/60 = 56/3 = 18(2)/(3) km

Total distance covered by the person = 56(1)/(4) + 18(2)/(3) 

⇒ (56 + 18) + (1)/(4) + (2)/(3) = 74 + (11)/(12) = 74(11)/(12) km

**∴ The correct answer is 74(11)/(12) km.**

questions.question: 20 students of a college went to a hotel. 19 of them spent Rs. 175 each on their meal and the 20th student spent Rs. 19 more than the average of all the 20. Find the total money spent by them.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 20

19 students spent = 175 each

**Formula used:**

Average cost = Total cost/total number of person

**Calculation:**

Let the 20th student spend = X

According to the question:

⇒ (19 × 175 + X)/20 = X - 19

⇒ (3325 + X) = 20 × (X - 19)

⇒ 3325 + X = 20X - 380

⇒ 19X = 3325 + 380 = 3705

⇒ X = 3705/19 = Rs.195

Total money spent at hotel = (19 × 175) + 195 

⇒ 3325 + 195 = Rs.3520

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.3520.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Total Student = 20

Let Avg spend by 20 students = y

Total spend = 20y

⇒ 20y = 19 × 175 + (y + 19)

⇒ 19y = 3344

⇒ y = 176

Total spend = 20 × 176

**∴ Total money spent by them is Rs. 3520**

questions.question: Money was lent on simple interest. After 12 years, its simple interest becomes (3)/(5) of the money. Find the rate of interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage = (3 ÷ 5) × 100 = 60%

We know directly that Total SI% = Rate × Time

60% = Rate × 12

Rate = 60 ÷ 12 = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

⇒ Let the Principal amount be P and the Rate of interest be R% p.a.

⇒ Given Time (T) = 12 years

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) after 12 years = (3 ÷ 5) × P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83b0ae8cac415066ebd2fb6682632b4c893a8f081ab948cacb5eadbf1765884.png] 

⇒ Formula: Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ (3 ÷ 5) × P = (P × R × 12) ÷ 100

⇒ 3 ÷ 5 = (12 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ R = (3 × 100) ÷ (5 × 12)

⇒ R = 300 ÷ 60

⇒ R = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is strictly calculated only on the principal amount, whereas Compound Interest is calculated on the principal amount as well as the accumulated interest from previous periods.

Difference between CI and SI

For 2 years, Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)². For 3 years, Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)² × (3 + R ÷ 100).

Compound Interest Formula

Amount = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ, where n is the number of years or compounding periods. The Compound Interest is obtained by subtracting the Principal from the Amount (CI = Amount − P).

questions.question: Racer A and racer B run a race of 18 km on a circular track of length 800 m. Both complete one round in 200 sec and 250 sec, respectively. After how much time from the start will the faster person meet the slower person for the last time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total race between A and B = 18 km

Length of a circular track = 800 m

Time taken by A to complete the 1st round = 200 sec

Time taken by B to complete the 1st round = 250 sec

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Total race between A and B = 18 km = 18000 m

Number of rounds to complete the race = 18000/800 = 22.5 rounds

Time taken by A to complete the 1st round = 200 sec

For 22.5 round = 200 × 22.5 = 4500 sec.

When A and B start running,

The first meeting will occur at L.C.M (200, 250) = 1000 sec.

Fourth meet will be = 1000 × 4 = 4000 sec.

For the next meeting,

Time would be 5000 sec, which is impossible as A completes the race in 4500 sec.

But, to complete 22.5 rounds A takes 4500 sec. So the time cannot be more than 4500 sec.

So, the faster person meets the slower person at 4000 sec.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
